 Thanks to MAMA 2026, BTS became the K-pop group with the most Daesang awards.
 Winning at MAMA 2026 brought BTS's total number of Daesang awards to 80, setting a record for the artist with the most Daesang awards in K-pop history.
 Báo Tuổi Trẻ • 20/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 BTS won the Daesang Artist of the Year award at MAMA 2026 - Photo: Big Hit Music
 On the evening of November 20th, the MAMA 2026 awards ceremony officially took place at Kyocera Dome Osaka, Japan , with the first night themed "A Music Interstellar."
 BTS was absent from MAMA once again, but the group still won in many categories, including the Daesang Artist of the Year award.
 No one can surpass BTS. 
 With this achievement, BTS continues to solidify their position in the history of Korean music. The group now possesses a total of 80 different Daesang awards, becoming the K-pop artist with the most Daesang awards.
 Although unable to attend the awards ceremony in person due to their world tour schedule, BTS still delivered their acceptance speech via video . Notably, this win coincides with the 10th anniversary of the group's first Daesang award at MAMA. 
 BTS expressed their gratitude to fans for their support throughout the years - Photo: Mnet
 V shared that this milestone makes this year's award even more special, and also expressed regret that the group couldn't celebrate with the audience in person.
 "Every time we receive an award at such a wonderful awards ceremony, we feel our responsibility growing even greater."
 "I think it's thanks to our fans that we were able to overcome that pressure and keep moving forward. You all mean so much to us," J-Hope shared.
 Previously, BTS also won both the Daesang awards for Artist of the Year and Album of the Year at the Melon Music Awards. With their victory at MAMA, the group continues to affirm its strong influence in 2026.
 CL "rocked" MAMA with Allday Project.
 You may also like One of the most attention-grabbing performances on the first night of MAMA 2026 was the collaboration between CL and the junior group Allday Project. Titled "Still The Baddies ," the performance marked her return to MAMA, bringing back songs associated with 2NE1's name to a large audience.
 CL released the song "Iconic" on November 20th. This is the female artist's first musical release in 5 years. Just a few hours after its release, she performed the song for the first time on the MAMA stage, much to the excitement of the audience. 
 CL performed "I Am the Best" along with "Allday Project" at MAMA.
 Following "Iconic ," the atmosphere at Kyocera Dome Osaka heated up again as the melody of "Fire, I Am the Best" filled the air. Annie, Bailey, and Youngseo Allday Project appeared alongside CL, helping to recreate the iconic lineup of the legendary girl group.
 Annie and Bailey, along with CL, rocked the stage with energetic rap verses. Meanwhile, Youngseo took over Park Bom's vocals. The combination created a performance reminiscent of 2NE1 but still with the mark of a younger generation of artists.
 Besides CL's performance, MAMA 2026 also had many memorable moments. ENHYPEN won the Fans' Choice of the Year award for the second consecutive year. This was a particularly emotional victory for the group, as the members broke down in tears on stage after receiving the award. 
 ENHYPEN burst into tears upon receiving the Fans' Choice of the Year award - Photo: Mnet
 Group leader Jungwon shared that this year has been a turbulent one. He recounted moments when the members wondered if the group could remain stable. However, even when they themselves lacked confidence, the audience always placed their faith in the group.
 MAMA 2026 will continue with its second night on November 21st, featuring a lineup including BigBang, IVE, Le Sserafim, CORTIS... The remaining two Daesang awards, Album of the Year and Song of the Year, will also be announced the following night. 
 IVE was named the best girl group at MAMA 2026 - Photo: Mnet 
 Some of the awards at the MAMA 2026 Awards Ceremony on Day 1
 - Daesang Artist of the Year : BTS
 You may also like - Fans' Choice of the Year: ENHYPEN
 - Fans' Choice Top 10: ENHYPEN, ILLIT, TREASURE, CORTIS, TUIDE, BABYMONSTER, LNGSHOT, Hearts2Hearts
 - Best Female Group: IVE
 - Best New Artist : Alpha Drive One, TUIDE
 - The next promising artist: RESCENE
 - Best Breakthrough Artist: NCT WISH
